exposure: routine administration of pharmacologic venous thromboembolism (VTE) prophylaxis
outcome: proportion of patients experiencing unplanned delivery within 12 hours of typical enoxaparin dosing
cohort: Pregnant patients admitted for expectant management of preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM) who remained undelivered after 72 hours of admission, with delivery at <=35 weeks gestation and rupture of membranes at <=34 weeks.
finding: A quarter (24%) of patients admitted for PPROM had an unplanned delivery within 12 hours of typical enoxaparin dosing.
gest_age: PPROM (preterm, i.e., <37 weeks gestation), with included patients delivering at <=35 weeks and rupture of membranes at <=34 weeks
